# Build notes

These files are the working notes of the sessions that built this project. Every one was last changed on 2026-10-19, the build day, and they are kept as written.

Every figure, status and plan in them is as of its date and is not updated. A note here that says a quarter is still to be locked or scored was true when it was written. The current figures are in the [main README](../../README.md), the live record is in `results/live/`, and the notes of the pre-publication audit are in [docs/prepub/](../prepub/).

One known error in these notes: `DECISIONS.md` (line 110) says the 2024Q3 band uses nearest-rank position 4. The code uses position 3, as the preregistered formula says, because `0.1 * 30` is exactly `3.0` in floating point. No figure is affected.

`FACT_CHECK.md` items F1 and F2 say `report/note.html` prints two G300 claims. Those two claims were removed after that check. On 2026-11-11 the pre-publication audit put the same two facts back under new ids (`pc-g300-replaces-g280`, `pc-g280-final-delivery`) with the wording `FACT_CHECK.md` proposed, so the note carries them again.
